$comment: One sentence per gist revision, keyed by the revision's commit sha (history.json `version`). Hand-written; the daily refresh never touches this file. A new revision with no note renders without one.

notes.2a8d004750914fbb98719b92f4c5ef76c5690591: First draft: The Urlist on Next.js and SQLite, with anonymous and account-owned lists, soft delete and restore, live metadata, QR codes and a mock GitHub login.
notes.aba7318a8e8b7bfeb134d7fc0bdf03b1412deef9: Adds a Required design skill section that mandates the Postrboard design language and makes drag-and-drop the primary way to reorder links.
notes.f7b0aa140d6d644dc113638e996e5038811ae892: Condenses the whole document: one exact stack list, a five-row routes table, and the metadata, alias, login and accessibility rules cut to a paragraph each.
notes.3fb7ac35ff5de91758fd8f5adc01bbf8c31f7496: Makes the server authoritative on every write, moves the edit and public routes to catch-all alias segments, and folds the reorder and test lists into prose.
notes.b5c6580939d876a6a233487f87280fe485523502: Adds a Completion step: walk every user journey in a real Chromium browser before declaring the app done.
notes.4a9f7ff9b94db49b41eea832c1055228b096de9d: Adds the Technical specification and checklist section: commit a spec with a verifiable checkbox per requirement and reconcile it before finishing.
notes.f3d7c702dd8db7d5de822f6d02eead7a3cfc19c6: Makes the reference Blazor app the source of truth: exact copy per screen, Bulma tokens, one-segment vanity routes, and permanent delete replacing soft delete.
notes.91d8de389199a7580f49f064f103f48259cc024c: Reverses the styling call: the reference app now defines behavior and copy only, and every screen is restyled with Postrboard instead of Bulma and Font Awesome.
notes.40dda421deff6f9402976e5df59d99a61233433b: Makes structure part of the UX: the publish bar is a full-width band, link rows are cards of plain text edited in place, and My Lists tiles get exact anatomy.
notes.146f7b7d8efaf15b69099aec2fea97e3f8146bd2: Details the Home page layout: top-aligned columns, a hero of three cascading browser windows, and a full-bleed Get Started band with a full-width link input.
notes.cc663f0ef9360fa6ff6361b28bd0c55a336f6164: Adds a Mocks section with six screenshots of the reference app in place of the paragraph pointing at its source repository.
notes.453e813605b167e1d3b03284b8edcd818b0475e9: Drops Postrboard and the replicate-the-reference rules; the design system is now simply Bulma CSS with Font Awesome icons.
notes.9631dfead3c278914fda40b6fe8ecf7ce3307ea0: Spells out the Bulma choice: no second framework, Font Awesome placeholder and not-found icons, an inline SVG hero in Bulma colors, and Bulma's own dark mode.
notes.df7f13bd50b2187484323492c6899fc087edb0af: Replaces the six unlabeled screenshots with seven captioned ones: Home, New List, validation states, login modal, My Lists, published list and its QR code.
notes.05ce1c964abbce4ac1ea86ee6a6b29f91bd383ae: Adds a Finally section asking the agent to open the finished site in a browser for the user to evaluate.
notes.8ef29d7eecb97ecbbd5a89ff4a7375482364704f: Removes the Finally section added in revision 15, restoring the text of revision 14.
